{{Quote|I am from the Rohair Biomechanical Clinic. I was sent to meet you.|Irin Fossyr|<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rohair Biomechanical Clinic''' was the place cited by [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] as proof of her identity to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] during their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
